phase5_tenant_isolation.nobypassrls_note: RLS policies are only enforced when the API/worker connect as a NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS role that does not own the tables. The local docker-compose `dev` user is a superuser, so policies are bypassed there. Create `nash_app` with apps/api/scripts/create_app_db_role.sql and point DATABASE_URL at it (keep Alembic on the owner role).
